high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website "India Today." The article is titled "Storm in Bangladesh as ex-President leaves for Thailand in lungi on 3 am flight." The headline suggests that former President Abdul Hamid left Bangladesh for Thailand in the early hours of the morning, wearing a lungi (a traditional garment), which is unusual for such an event. The article provides context about the situation in Bangladesh, mentioning that it has become the latest Awami League leader to leave the country after the fall of the Sheikh Hasina regime.
